tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches the open job postings listed on FullTime with Benefits (fwbjobs.com): employers' own postings from their careers sites and public job centres, in Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Monaco, Morocco, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, Switzerland and the United Arab Emirates.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns one open job listed on FullTime with Benefits with the posting's full text in its own language, the address to apply at and the employer's original posting.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds companies that have a public page on FullTime with Benefits by a word of their name. Returns up to 8, with the number of their open jobs.

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: Returns a company's public page on FullTime with Benefits: what it says about itself and its newest open jobs (up to 20).
